purpose: High-precision reconstruction with primary emphasis on motion.

motion.error_unit: Mean absolute final-node channel error divided by fixed reference amplitude, retaining existing minimum amplitudes (8 canvas pixels, opacity .1, angle .03).

formula: Each check is linearly scored between good and bad, clipped to [0,100]. Average checks within object and dimension, average objects per dimension, then apply dimension weights.
comparison_note: This is a new, stricter rubric adopted after seeing v1. Scores are comparable only under the same rubric version.
